annotations.title: Get M&A multiples trend by year

description: Read-only. Year-by-year history for ONE sub-vertical: for each deal year 2018-2026, the median EV/EBITDA and/or EV/Revenue multiple with middle 50% (25th-75th percentile), deal count n and median deal value. Only years with at least 10 disclosed deals for a metric are shown; missing years are listed as gaps and never interpolated, so many sub-verticals have few or no years. Use it for 'are multiples rising or falling for X?' questions; use get_valuation_multiples for pooled current figures by deal size.

industry.description: Sub-vertical id from list_industries (e.g. 'hvac', 'dental-practice'), or a plain-English name ('HVAC', 'dentist', 'plumber', 'MSP'); plain names are mapped to the closest tracked category and the answer says which one was used.

metric.description: Optional: ev_ebitda or ev_revenue. Omit to show both where published.

name: get_multiples_trend
